title: Mattermost versions 11.7.x <= 11.7.11 fail to enforce the team view permission across all filter combinations of the…
description: Mattermost versions 11.7.x up to 11.7.11 have a vulnerability where the team view permission is not properly enforced across all filter combinations of the user listing endpoint. This flaw allows an authenticated user to enumerate members of a team they are not authorized to view by crafting specific requests to that endpoint. The issue is identified as CVE-2026-18643 and has a low severity rating.
